thread:
Aisha: Heads up — releasebot auto-bumped to 1.8.0 for #482 infra-only changes. I thought infra-only should be patch-only. Any reason for minor?
Tom: I saw that, looks like package.json had a semver field changed? But it's just a Dockerfile tweak.
deploy-bot: releasebot v0.9.3 created tag v1.8.0 because it detected changes in package.json 'engines' field. Rule: bumpMinorIfNonSemverStable=true.
Riley: That rule seems aggressive for infra tweaks. We want: patch for docs/config/deploy infra; minor only when API/contract changes.
Marta: Agreed. Can we add heuristics: PR labels 'api-change' or 'public-api' to force minor, otherwise default patch? Also respect explicit [major/minor/patch] in commit message.
Tom: Propose: default patch for paths matching /^infra\/|^charts\/|^deploy\/ or files Dockerfile, helm charts; minor only if any code under pkg/public/ or openapi spec changed.
Aisha: Sounds good. Also question: should we preserve buildmeta on patch tags? Right now releasebot drops +buildmeta. That breaks reproducible builds.
Lewis: I can add a flag to keep buildmeta for patch tags: --preserve-buildmeta. But need policy: do we keep for all patches or only if CI provides artifact id?
Riley: Keep if CI_ARTIFACT_ID present. Otherwise strip.
Marta: Another edge: rollback criteria — if a patch includes runtime config that causes perf regressions, we should still allow patch rollback without bumping semver again. How do we track rollbacks in changelog?
Tom: We tag rollback commits with v1.7.3-rollback.N and note in release notes. Keep mainline tag names strictly semver; rollback tags are suffixed.
Aisha: Implementation tasks: 1) change releasebot heuristics to default patch for infra paths; 2) accept [minor] or [patch] in PR title to override; 3) add --preserve-buildmeta conditional on CI variable; 4) docs update in RELEASE_PROCESS.md.
deploy-bot: Created issue #2109 for heuristic change. Assigned to @Lewis. Will open PR for preserve-buildmeta.
Lewis: I'll pick up #2109 and draft the PR this afternoon. Will add unit tests for path matching.
Riley: Thanks — tagging the ops channel when heuristics land so deployers are aware :thumbsup: 
Aisha: Thanks all. We'll target the change for the next change window (Thu 02:00 UTC).
